About the author


### William Lyon


William Lyon is an AI engineer at Hypermode where he works to help practitioners put AI apps into production. Previously he worked as a software developer at Neo4j and other startups. He is also the author of the book “Fullstack GraphQL Applications” and earned a master's degree in Computer Science from the University of Montana. You can find him online at http://lyonwj.com.
